## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe what changes as a result, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

### Pre-merge acceptance

Describe checks actually run and their results, including missing or environment-blocked checks. Confirm implementation and applicable mandatory pre-merge acceptance are complete; state remaining scope for intentional partial work. Use the [change-appropriate validation guidance](https://github.com/takahirox/web-ar-occlusion/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#test-and-ci-principles).

### Required post-merge verification

List only checks this change needs, with expected results and evidence destinations (merged PR, closed Issue, or linked validation report), or state **none required**. Keep unperformed checks pending and identify environment blockers. Documentation/template edits alone need no deployment, model download, or device run. Follow the [post-merge evidence and linked-defect procedure](https://github.com/takahirox/web-ar-occlusion/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#6-perform-required-post-merge-verification); closure does not claim these checks passed.

## Related issues

Use `Closes #N` for a fully implemented Issue with mandatory pre-merge acceptance satisfied, including when post-merge-only verification is pending. For intentional partial work, link the parent Issue without an automatic closing reference and state remaining scope. Follow the [merge and closure lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/web-ar-occlusion/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#5-merge).
